description: Functions and classes for working with Itasca CFD balls.

functions.name: count
functions.description: Get the number of CFD balls.

functions.name: find
functions.description: Get the CFD ball object with the given ID number.

functions.name: inbox
functions.signature: itasca.ball.cfd.inbox(lower_bound: vec, upper_bound: vec, intersect=True) -> Tuple of CFD ball objects
functions.description: Get a tuple of CCFD balls with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the CFD ball. The if the optional keyword argument intersect is False then only CFD balls with positions falling in the box are returned.

functions.name: list
functions.description: Get a CFD ball iterator object.

functions.name: maxid
functions.description: Get the maximum CFD ball ID.

functions.name: near
functions.signature: itasca.ball.cfd.near(point: vec, radius=0.0) -> CFD ball object
functions.description: Find the closest CFD ball to a point. If the optional keyword argument radius is non-zero, only search within this radius.
